source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    mid = len(grid[0]) // 2
    left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
    right = [row[mid + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    if left_bg == right_bg:
        bg = left_bg
        return [[bg if a != b else 3 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    bg = max(shared, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in left for v in row) + sum(v == c for row in right for v in row))
    return [[3 if a == b else bg for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
'''
